Primary CTA link, e.g. 'Explore Internet plans'.
Wide hero image of Xfinity Internet or WiFi in the home.
Section heading that sets up the guide.
Intro paragraph, clear and jargon-free, framing what the reader will learn.
Heading for the first explainer section (e.g. gig-speed fiber).
Body paragraph explaining the concept in everyday terms.
Supporting image for section 1.
Heading for the second explainer section (e.g. xFi Gateway).
Body paragraph for section 2.
Supporting image for section 2.

Body paragraph for section 3.
Supporting image for section 3.
